blue.$description: Primary — extracted from the official Visit Chandler logo SVG (23 fills). Contrast on white 7.8:1

teal.$description: Secondary — extracted from the official logo SVG; accents & highlights only. 2.3:1 on white — never text

navy.$description: Proposed interface colour (deep navy) — not a logo colour

ink-soft.$description: Body copy on white — 7.0:1 (6.6:1 on mist)

usage-rules.teal-text: Teal #00C1A0 on white is 2.3:1 — never use for text. Use teal-700 #00715E (6.0:1) for teal text.
usage-rules.blue-text: Brand blue #214FA1 on white is 7.8:1 — AA/AAA for text.
usage-rules.navy-on-teal: Navy #172B4D on teal #00C1A0 is 6.1:1 — used for primary CTA buttons. teal-600 #008A73 (4.3:1) is for icons/graphics only (≥3:1).

navy.$description: chandleraz.gov theme primary (most used colour in City CSS)

gold.$description: chandleraz.gov theme highlight — data emphasis on dark only
